subject: Critical Thinking
subcategory: Evidence & Truth: How We Know What's Real
title: Evidence-Based Thinking in Everyday Life
description: One-minute skill: Evidence-Based Thinking in Everyday Life.

hook.text: You don't need a lab to think like a scientist.

buildup.text: Evidence-Based Thinking in Everyday Life sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: It started in medicine (evidence-based medicine) and spread to education, policy, management, and personal decisions.

twist.text: It doesn't mean ignoring experience — it means combining experience with data and updating when new evidence appears.

climax.text: Evidence-Based Thinking in Everyday Life matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Three questions a day keep bad reasoning away.

quiz.question: What is the core habit of evidence-based thinking?
options: Making decisions based on best available evidence, not just intuition
